description: Where each line item is in production, per item plus a rollup. Stages (in order): received, in preflight, awaiting proof, proof approved, imposing, queued for print, sent to Caldera, printing, printed, at Zund cutter, cut, dispatched. Needs-action states: missing file, preflight failed, with design team, on hold (unpaid), proof rejected, duplicate. Each item also returns the press and the print timestamp.

customer_email.description: The email address on the order. REQUIRED for identity — order details are only returned when this email matches the order. The customer must give their email AND one of their order numbers.

line_item_id.description: Optional Shopify line item GID to scope to one item.

order_name.description: Human order name, e.g. "#12345" (alias for order_id).

name: vivid_fulfilment_production_stage
